question: P is the father of Q. Q is the husband of R. S is the daughter of R. How is P related to S?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) P is the father of Q.

2) Q is the husband of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7df282945d38f895df4a6f17bccf292f818942c6d88513102679964222d4907.png] 

3) S is the daughter of R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5ad64bb65a6004aee2539d5c4cd360dbe6b3ea1bb42b6a3ae054c7815e9801a.png] 

Thus, P is S's grandfather.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
